error.connection_failed: Failed to connect to remote machine

list.title: PCs
list.unavailable_hint: Can't connect to an offline PC

empty.title: No PCs added yet
empty.body: On the PC you want to watch, open the Desk-Remote Agent and enter the code it shows here.

none.title: No matching PCs
none.body: Try changing the search or the filter.

err.title: Couldn't load the list
err.body: The PC list couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

pair.title: Add PC

code.label: Code shown on the PC
code.hint: 8 characters. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once.

name.label: PC name (optional)
name.hint: If left empty, the PC's own name is used.

step1.title: Open the agent on the PC
step1.body: Start the Desk-Remote Agent on the remote PC.

step2.title: Show the code
step2.body: Click “Show pairing code” in the agent; an 8-character code appears.

step3.title: Enter it here
step3.body: Type or paste the code in the field on the left.

invalid.title: Invalid code
invalid.detail: Check the code. Enter letters and digits exactly as shown on the PC.

expired.title: The code has expired
expired.detail: Click “Show new code” on the PC and enter the new one.

used.title: This code was already used
used.detail: Each code works once. Generate a new one on the PC.

network.title: Couldn't reach the PC
network.detail: Check your connection (local network or Tailscale) and try again.

ok.title: PC paired
ok.body: {name} is now in your list. You can connect right away.

pair.demo: Demo backend: ABCD-2345 succeeds · EXPR-0000 expired · USED-1111 already used · NETW-0000 network error · anything else is invalid

mode.control_hint: Mouse and keyboard go to the remote PC

toast.control: Control on — mouse and keyboard now go to the remote PC

lost.title: Connection lost
lost.fail_body: {name} didn't respond after {max} attempts. The PC may be off or disconnected from the network.

unsupported.title: This system can't decode H.264
unsupported.body: The WebView does not provide hardware or software H.264 decoding.

palette.title: Palette
palette.hint: Pick a color family. It applies immediately.

tailscale.title: Connection
tailscale.hint: The panel reaches PCs on your local network, or anywhere through Tailscale. No server of your own is needed.
tailscale.missing: Tailscale isn't installed on this PC.
tailscale.connecting: Waiting for sign-in in your browser…
tailscale.connect_hint: A sign-in page opens in your browser. Once you finish, this status turns to connected.
tailscale.failed: Couldn't start the sign-in. Try again.

key.title: Key for farm PCs
key.hint: Farm PCs without a screen can join your network with a one-time key. Create it in the Tailscale admin page (enable “One-off”), paste it below, and run the command on the farm PC.
key.label: One-time key
